sloka: तारितो ऽहं त्वया पुत्र सुपुत्रेण महात्मना ।अष्टावक्रेण धर्मात्मा तारितो ब्राह्मणो यथा ।। ६.१२२.१७ ।।
transliteration: tārito 'haṁ tvayā putra suputreṇa mahātmanā ।aṣṭāvakreṇa dharmātmā tārito brāhmaṇo yathā ।। 6.122.17 ।।

translations.english: "Son! I am liberated by you today, my great son, just as Kahola who was set on righteousness was liberated by Ashtavakra."
